english: You can understand, in the same way, how to reply as well to cases where someone sets forth—as an example—an illusion, or a reflection in a mirror, as being equivalent to a state of mind with a sense power that has cataracts. And you should also understand, in the same way, the illustration of when a state of mind arises in craving spirits wherein they perceive a stream of fresh water as being pus & blood.
